svg.title: Host adapters and separate distribution trust
svg.desc: Shared application / projects / engine / CLI / authenticated HTTP / 17 MCP tools. Windows: LocalAppData + DPAPI | macOS: Application Support + Keychain | Linux: XDG + Secret Service. Measured voice: Windows SAPI / OneCore | macOS say | Linux eSpeak NG | explicit OpenAI option. Media: Windows / Mac bundled FFmpeg | Linux system FFmpeg | provider tools installed separately. Windows: Azure publisher signing + staged updates | Mac: ad-hoc only, no notarization | Linux: unsigned. Mac / Linux manual replacement | source installer creates isolated environment + desktop launcher

g.text: Host adapters and separate distribution trust
